picture-pairs.name: Omafano a faafana
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Oshikoka sho kupandja aantu yomaholike: Omathano gaayiwa
picture-pairs.h1: Omafano a faafana: Oudano wombili wokutula omafano kumwe
picture-pairs.description: Oshikoka she efile, she nomhango, kaaholike nomaakwaaluwa, pamwe naantu ya kala nedementia. Omathano ota kala ta holoka. Kahe na ohoro nahe na omaliko.
picture-pairs.short: Konga omafano avali a faafana. Omafano otaa dulu okukala e li wetike.
picture-pairs.intro: Nyenya efano, opo nee to nyenye olo la faafana nalo. Omafano ohaa kala e wetike, opo kuha kale sha sha pumbwa okudimbulukwa. Ngeenge omafano avali otaa tu kumwe, ohaa mono omunghulo woshingoldo noshididiliko sheyapulo.
howTo: Hoolola kutya oto longo noukalata vangapi. Oukalata vane ovehovelo liwa li na ombili.
Nyenya efano keshe. Otali mono omunghulo woshingoldo.
Nyenya efano olo la faafana nalo. Omafano avali otaa kala pamwe noshididiliko sheyapulo.
Ngeenge omafano avali kae fi amwe, kape na sha shii tashi ningwa. Nyenya vali efimbo keshe to kala we lilongekida.
Pana "Omafano a holekwa" ashike ngeenge amushe omwa hafela onghedi yonale yomafano a tala pedu.
tips: Tumbuleni mokule omadina omafano pamwe ndele tamu kundafana kombinga yao: "Okakopi kotee katilyana. Oho tula omaele motee yoye?"
Efa omunhu ou to file oshisho oye a nyenye, nonande tashi pula efimbo. Ulika ponhele yokunyenyena ko.
Kaleni noukalata vane efimbo alishe olo tamu mono shiwa. Oukalata vahapu ehoololo ashike, kae fi onghatu oyo mu na okuhanga.
Xulifeni fimbo oshili shihokiye. Oudano umwe ashike oshilonga sha wanina po.

faq.q: Ope na efimbo lokuvalula ile eembinga?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na oloola, eembinga, okuvalula omalinyengo ile ekanifo. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe, nokweefa pokati onghedi iwa lela yokumanifa.

faq.q: Omolwashike omafano haa kala a tala pombada?
faq.a: Okukaleka omafano e wetike otashi ningi oudano u kale wokutala nokufaafanifa ponhele yokudimbuluka. Ovanhu vahapu oveshi wete shi na ombili. Oto dulu okulundululila komafano a holekwa menyenyo limwe ngeenge osho wa hala.

faq.q: Oshoshali ngoo, noonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Ehee, oshoshali, nokape na ombapila yokulishangifa ile okunanghifa mo sha. Ohashi longo mokukonakoni ko-inthaneta kongodi, kootablete ile kokompiyuta.

faq.q: Ohatu dulu okulongifa omafano etu mwene oukwaneumbo?
faq.a: Ehee. Kendeka Photo pairs, oyo hai ku pe omhito yokuhoolola omafano moshikwaelektroniki shoye. Omafano ohaa kala ashike mokukonakoni koye nokaetuminwa ko-inthaneta.

find-the-same.name: Konga olo la faafana
find-the-same.seoTitle: Mona ethano lihedi: Oshikoka shethano shiyapuka
find-the-same.description: Ethano limwe pombanda, omathano mahepe kumwe nomane pamuhe. Ilonga ethano li hedi. Oshikoka sho kuholoka shethano she efile, shaakwaaluwa, shaayimbi nomafuku, kahe na ohoro.
find-the-same.short: Tala kefano li li pombada ndele to nyenye olo la faafana nalo pedu.
find-the-same.intro: Efano limwe ole li pombada yokashikwaelektroniki. Pedu lalo ope na omafano avali, atatu ile ane. Nyenya olo la faafana nalo. Oshi li ehoololo lipu limwe lwofimbo, li na omhito ya kola yokupopya.
howTo: Hoolola omafano avali, atatu ile ane oo to hoolola muo. Avali oo mapu unene.
Taleni pamwe kefano li li pombada.
Nyenya efano la faafana nalo li li pedu. Otali didilikwa neshididiliko sheyapulo neendjovo dimwe ditunhula.
Ngeenge panyenywa efano le lili, oudano otau tumbula ashike edina lalo ndele tau teelele. Kape na okululumuka.
Nyenya "Efano tali landula" ngeenge mwe lilongekida vali limwe.
tips: Popyafani kombinga yefano keshe fimbo inamu hoolola: omalwaalo, eembumbo, nopo mwe li monene nale.
Omahoololo avali kae fi "mapu unene". Elalakano olo okukala nefimbo lihokiye, hakukondja.
Ngeenge okunyena okudjuu, omunhu ota dulu okuulika ndele to mu nyenyene ko.

faq.q: Ope na efimbo lokuvalula ile eembinga?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na oloola, eembinga, okuvalula omalinyengo ile ekanifo. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe, nokweefa pokati onghedi iwa lela yokumanifa.

faq.q: Oshike tashi ningwa po ngeenge panyenywa efano lihe fi lo?
faq.a: Kape na sha shii. Kape na okalunga ke na onyanya, omushiyakano mutilyana ile okukakama. Oudano otau tumbula ashike edina lefano la nyenywa ndele tau teelele enyenyo tali landula.

faq.q: Oshoshali ngoo, noonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Ehee, oshoshali, nokape na ombapila yokulishangifa ile okunanghifa mo sha. Ohashi longo mokukonakoni ko-inthaneta kongodi, kootablete ile kokompiyuta.

shadow-match.name: Faafanifa nomudidimbe
shadow-match.seoTitle: Oshikoka shomatanga elumbu: Efile mo peyulu
shadow-match.description: Elumbu lilimbi pombanda, omathano mahepe kumwe nomane pamuhe. Ilonga ethano li na elumbu. Oshikoka shomatanga elumbu she efile, she kahe na ohoro.
shadow-match.short: Tala komudidimbe ndele to nyenye efano olo tali u ningi.
shadow-match.intro: Okufaafanifa nomudidimbe oshilonga sha shiivika komapapila omadheulo, apa tashi ningwa nomafano manene nopehe na sha shokushikisha. Omudidimbe omuwa ou li pombada yokashikwaelektroniki nomafano avali, atatu ile ane oku li pedu. Nyenya efano olo tali ningi omudidimbe oo. Eembumbo ngaashi okambasikela, okambwela ile okakopi kotee omapu yo okupopyafana kombinga yao.
howTo: Hoolola omafano avali, atatu ile ane oo to hoolola muo. Avali oo mapu unene.
Taleni pamwe komudidimbe. Oumbumbo wao owashike? Oule ile obulungudu?
Nyenya efano olo tali ningi omudidimbe. Edina lalo otali holoka koshi yomudidimbe.
Ngeenge panyenywa efano le lili, oudano otau tumbula ashike edina lalo ndele tau teelele. Kape na okululumuka.
Nyenya "Omudidimbe tau landula" ngeenge mwe lilongekida vali umwe.
tips: Landula omukanka womudidimbe nomunwe ndele tamu kundafana kombinga yombumbo yawo.
Ngeenge omididimbe oda fa didjuu nena, lundululila ko-Konga olo la faafana, oko omafano e li wetike nawa.
Popyafani kombinga yefano ngeenge la monika: "Otwa li tu na okambwela ka fa aka."

faq.q: Ope na efimbo lokuvalula ile eembinga?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na oloola, eembinga, okuvalula omalinyengo ile ekanifo. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe, nokweefa pokati onghedi iwa lela yokumanifa.

faq.q: Aantu ya kala nedementia ohaya kala ta kondja oshikoka shomatanga elumbu?
faq.a: Aantu ayehe ye li ngoo oya kondja, nosho ngoo aantu mbaka ya kala nedementia, kaatuwa mo mondjila yokutameka. Iiyambo oyo ya li ngoo ya tala ohaa li ilongwa kuyo kutya oyo oyo. Oshikoka otashi kalelwa okukondjwa nokupopiwa, ihashi ka tula ondjila kashi. Ngele otashi kala nomakalomo, lilongele Mona ethano lihedi, nenge ngoo tala omathano pamwe.

faq.q: Oshike hashi ningwa po ngeenge efano la puka la finyinikwa?
faq.a: Kape na sha shii hashi ningwa po. Kape na ewi lii, omushiyakano mutilyane ile ekakamo lofilima. Oudano ohau tumbula ashike edina lefano la finyinikwa ndele tau teelele efinyino tali landula.

faq.q: Oshali tuu, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshali, nokape na e-akaunta, okulishangifa ile okukutha ko ko-interneta. Ohashi longo mokukongifo ko-web kongodi, kotableta ile kokompiuta.

four-together.name: Efile pamwe
four-together.seoTitle: Oshikoka sho kuhangana omathano aaholike: Efile pamwe
four-together.h1: Efile pamwe: Oshikoka shokuhangana omathano she holokela
four-together.description: Omathano mamwe ga li nosho limwe, ngaashi omahama nenge elelo. Ilonga omathano ga li pamwe. Oshikoka she efile, she holokela, kahe na ohoro nahe na omaliko.
four-together.short: Hanga omathano ga li pamwe, ngaashi omahama nenge elelo.
four-together.intro: Ehangano lomathano mahepe, omamwe gao ga li pamwe: omahama ane, nenge ngaashi omalaulo ane gokuenda. Ilonga omathano ga li nosho limwe. Ngele ethano kali pamwe nomamwe, oshikoka otashi popia ngoo nokulindila. Ompito yomakuwa oshikoka otashi holola ohoko, nomukalo “Holoka ehangano” otashi holola ohoko kutya ehangano otali ombelela nokuholoka ngoo ngele omu hala.
howTo: Hanga omathano mahepe, nenge mahepe matatu, nenge mane. Mahepe kuyo okomwahokololo, nomatatu ga li pamwe.
Lipalenga omathano pamwe nowe, nolipopiya kutya gaa li nosho sha kala shi tamwe.
Ilonga ethano limwe limwe lina okuya mo mo ehangano. Ota tambula ondonga yegolide nenge otumbwa.
Ngele ethano kali pamwe nomamwe, oshikoka otashi popia ngoo nokulindila. Kahe na ompito.
Ilonga “Holoka ehangano” ngele omu hala, nomo “Ehangano lipya” omathano gopya.
tips: Popia ngoo mbunda shoka u mono: “Ayo mapale mahepe gaa li ngaa mapangela.”
Kahe na ompito. Ondjila yomalaulo otayi pitika pamwe nomutumba, nove shi ndaka ngele ohu hala.
Popiyeni kombinga yehangano nokuyandjaa ko kanamo: omahama ohaa hala, oludi lomukosi, nenge ehalo lelelo.

faq.q: Oshikoka she na ohoro nenge omaliko?
faq.a: Ihaa. Oshikoka ihashi na ohoro, omaliko, omahesho gokuhetekela nenge okulugwa. Ove mu ka ndaka nawa ngele omu hala, nokundaka mepingo otashi kala ondjila yiwa yokukala nawa.

faq.q: Ngele ethano kali mehangano ota tilwa, otashi ti ngiini?
faq.a: Ihashi ningi ngoo eyelelo. Ihaa oshitokisho, ihaa ehunga lotsikila, ihaa okuhoha. Oshikoka otashi popia kutya ethano olo kali mehangano, nokulindila ondjila yopandunge.

faq.q: Omahangano ga li ngaa?
faq.a: Ga li iinima yomalaulo gomahoololo, ihaa oshipangelo shokuziva nawa: omahama, omaupuya, omapupi, elelo, iinzila yokuenda, iinima yokunwa oshikombo sho pombanda, nenge iinima yokupekwa mombanda. Ethano limwe ota kala mehangano limwe fa.

faq.q: Oshikoka she efile, nongaa ndi shi lombwela?
faq.a: Ee, oshikoka she efile, kahe na okulombwela nenge okuyandja omaina. Ota ningwa mokaneko, mopotablet nenge komudhiladhilo, nosho ngoo mu na omalongelo gewa.

odd-one-out.name: Ethano kali pamwe
odd-one-out.seoTitle: Oshikoka sho kuwana ethano kali pamwe: Efile kaaholike
odd-one-out.h1: Ethano kali pamwe: Oshikoka shethano shiyapuka
odd-one-out.description: Omathano atatu nenge ane, nomamwe ga li nosho limwe, ngaashi omahama nenge elelo. Ilonga ethano kali pamwe. Oshikoka she efile, shaakwaaluwa, kahe na ohoro nahe na omaliko.
odd-one-out.intro: Omathano atatu nenge ane, nomamwe ga li pamwe: omahama, nenge omalaulo gokuenda. Ilonga ethano kali pamwe. Ngele ethano li li pamwe nomamwe, oshikoka otashi popia kutya ota li pamwe, nokulindila. Ompito yomakuwa oshikoka otashi popia kutya omamwe ga li nosho limwe, “Ndi holoke” otashi holola ethano kali pamwe.

Lipalenga omathano pamwe nowe, nolipopiya kutya omanini gawo ga li nosho sha kala shi tamwe.
Ilonga ethano kali pamwe. Ote tambula ondonga yegolide nenge otumbwa.
Ngele ethano kali pamwe nomamwe, oshikoka otashi popia kutya ota li pamwe, nokulindila. Kahe na ompito.

Kahe na ompito. Ondjila yokupopia otayi pitika pamwe nomutumba, nove shi ndaka ngele ohu hala.
Ethano lilihe ohali kala ondjila yiwa yokupopia: omahama ohaa hala, ondjimbo yehunga, nenge elelo lelelo.

faq.a: Ihashi ningi ngoo eyelelo. Ihaa oshitokisho, ihaa ehunga lotsikila, ihaa okuhoha. Oshikoka otashi popia kutya ethano olo li pamwe nomamwe, nokulindila ondjila yopandunge.

faq.q: Ethano kali pamwe otali holwa ngaa?
faq.a: Omathano ga li koomanini gomalaulo gomahoololo, ihaa oshipangelo shokuziva nawa: omahama, omaupuya, omapupi, elelo, iinzila yokuenda, iinima yokunwa oshikombo sho pombanda, nenge iinima yokupekwa mombanda. Ethano limwe ota kala komanini limwe fa, nethano kali pamwe otali kala komanini gahe.

faq.q: Ti ola kala, kayi-ko?
faq.a: Eeno, ola kala, kayi-ko ondjila, kayi-ko okulamba noukwaameni nelikanda. Ota shi kola moshilongo shoshikando, muilonga yepaseko, mounyuni nomolyathi.

color-match.name: Okukwashitha eyuvi
color-match.h1: Okukwashitha eyuvi: Shaa iilitombo yeyuvi limwe
color-match.description: Eyuvi lomeme lilanga nelina lyalo, neitombo yomaa ne ine nelimwe kutya. Dunga oilitombo ilipe eyuvi elo. Kakuna etimbo, kakuna omapaloko, nomadulo mamwe okulanga ashishi nelina lyawo. Ota kola ondjila, ota shi kola okukulumbwa.
color-match.short: Shaa iilitombo ayihe iine eyuvi limwe nelo lilanga.
color-match.players: 1 nomuntu wa ihe 2, ngaho omukulunhu nomukwaname
color-match.intro: Otamu langa oshinyanga shomeme shoyuvi, nelina lyalo moshipaleshi, nomonkhoto oilitombo ine nelimwe kutya. Dunga oilitombo ilipe eyuvi elo, ngaashi omahapu omutuku nekopu yomutuku. Ngeenge omutombo gwa ya moshipala shimwe, omushaali gu ti elina lyawo ("Eshola olyo ntiyuvi.") ogwa tegelela. "Ndi ulike" ota ulike oilitombo ya fanene nayo nawa, "Eyuvi lilwe" ota ya kuhe.
howTo: Shaa oilitombo ine kumwe nomonkhoto. Ine kumwe oshimpe shoka.
Talululeni eyuvi, nolinyoleni elina lyalo pamwe.
Dunga oilitombo ilipe eyuvi elo. Yimwe nomwe ota ili ekwatho lipi nelikwatho lokalumbu.
Ngeenge omutombo gwa ya moshipala shimwe, omushaali ota popye eyuvi lyawo ogwa tegelela. Kala nou tegelele.
Dunga "Ndi ulike" sho ohaa hala, unene "Eyuvi lilwe" ngeenge oho hala eyuvi lipe.
tips: Lombwela eyuvi nawa, unene talenei moshilando: oshike shimwe she na eyuvi elo?
Ulika ombelewa dodu ngeenge ohu hala. "Omatimati" nangwe "ohinyu" otashi lombwelelwa nayo ngaashi "omutuku" nangwe "omulunga".
Okulonga omunwe otashi shi kola ngaashi okudunga. Kaleni po shikukuma kuyeno, opo mu mone ondjila mwa mona meho ayehe.

faq.q: Oku na etimbo nangwe omapaloko?
faq.a: Ina. Kakuna oshikando, omapaloko, omulongi gwomadulo nangwe okulimbwa. Ota shi kola okukula nonhumba yoyo, nokukula muuyuna ota ulike oshiwana shiza.

faq.q: Ngeenge omunwe gwa dungwa oilitombo ilipe eyuvi elo, oshike sha ka ningwa?
faq.a: Kakuna shimwe shi hepaleka. Kakuna oshimbo, kakuna omutanda gwomutuku nangwe okukaluka. Omutombo ogu langa oilitombo nalyo eyuvi lyayo, ngaashi "Eshola olyo ntiyuvi.", ogu tegelela okudunga okumbwanawa.

faq.q: Eyuvi ndilyo ondjadjiko yayo yonaa?
faq.a: Ina. Eyuvi olya lanzwa ngaashi oshinyanga shomeme, nolya nyolwa ngaashi ondjovi, nomutombo gwo gwa lipiwa shi na elina pamwe nokudungwa. Omuntu ha dulu okushaa eyuvi nomudo ota kola okukwashitha nokulinyola elina.

faq.q: Oilitombo ayihe ihayi kwashikidwa ngaa eyuvi limwe?
faq.a: Oilitombo oyi pewa mokulonga kwoonanona, ihayi kwatelwa mo ngeenge ekwatho lyayo lyapamwe ine eyuvi limwe nayo. Oilitombo ine eyuvi lilongo, ngaashi ekukwa nangwe enyuki, ihayi kwatwa mo.

faq.q: Oku na ondjalulo yepepa?
faq.a: Eeno. Elapa limwe lepepa line omulongo ine omilongo mine. Omulongo gumwe nagumwe gu lombwela eyuvi nogu ulika oilitombo ine ya lipiwa okulongo nangwe okutwika ombinga.

faq.q: Ota kola kweenda ngaa, nokuhala okukwatha okuyandja omanyino?
faq.a: Eeno, ota kola kweenda ngaa, kakuna ekwatho, okuyandjwa omanyino nangwe okulandulwa. Ota shi kola moshilongo shoshikando, muilonga yepaseko, mounyuni nomolyathi.

halves-match.name: Okushasha oihunga
halves-match.h1: Okushasha oihunga: Shasha oihunga ime yeitombo limwe
halves-match.description: Oihunga yekumona yeitombo ilipe nomwe ine mbali, oihunga yekumanene yayo ili mbali yimwe. Dunga oihunga imwe, unene imwe mbaka yayo. Kakuna etimbo, kakuna omapaloko, nomahunga ga hashi shasha ogaa tyapulwa. Ota kola ondjila, ota shi kola okukulumbwa.
halves-match.short: Dunga oihunga mbali imwe ine ya shasha pamwe okuhanga itombo limwe.
halves-match.players: 1 nomuntu wa ihe 2, ngaho omukulunhu nomukwaname
halves-match.intro: Eitombo nalyo otali kundwa komutumba. Oihunga yekumona yeitombo mbali yimwe ili mbali kepunga, oihunga yekumanene yayo, mokupangwa kwayo, ili mbali yimwe. Dunga ihunga imwe yekumona, unene dunga ihunga yekumanene ina shasha nayo, ngaashi ompompi yepoto nombulu yayo. Oihunga ina shasha oyi shasha yitombo limwe. Oihunga hayi shasha oyi tyapulwa, nomutombo ogu ti ngaho nosho nawa. "Ndi ulike" ota shasha oyo ayehe.
howTo: Shaa oitombo mbali yimwe nomwe ine mbali yimwe. Mbali yimwe ota ya nawa.
Talululeni oihunga yekumona pamwe. Mo shi oshike shimwe shimwe ihe li na ashike?
Dunga ihunga yekumona, unene dunga ihunga yekumanene ina shasha nayo. Ota kola okulonga nosho kashi kumwe.
Oihunga ina shasha oyi shasha, ine ekwatho lokalumbu nelikwatho lokulamba. Oihunga hayi shasha oyi tyapulwa, nowa kala nou dule okutaxwa.
Dunga "Ndi ulike" sho ohaa hala, unene "Oihunga ihupe" ngeenge oho hala oitombo ipe.
tips: Lipangela nomunwe kolwiyo lyihunga. Ehanga lyoitombo olya kwatela komutumba?
Lombwela shoka u mone: "Ihunga ili ina ekuhe." Ino pumbiwa okuhamba oitombo ayihe.
Okulonga omunwe otashi shi kola ngaashi okudunga. Kaleni po shikukuma kuyeno, opo mu mone ondjila mwa mona meho ayehe.

faq.q: Oku na etimbo nangwe omapaloko?
faq.a: Ina. Kakuna oshikando, omapaloko, omulongi gwomadulo nangwe okulimbwa. Ota shi kola okukula nonhumba yoyo, nokukula muuyuna ota ulike oshiwana shiza.

faq.q: Ngeenge oihunga mbali haayi shasha, oshike sha ka ningwa?
faq.a: Kakuna shimwe shi hepaleka. Kakuna oshimbo, kakuna omutanda gwomutuku nangwe okukaluka. Oihunga mbali oyi tyapulwa, nomutombo ogu ti: "Oyo mbali haayi shasha pamwe. Dunga imwe ihupe." Kakuna shi shi lipangwa.

faq.q: Oitombo oyi shi lipwilisa lwoka?
faq.a: Eeno. Oitombo oyi pewa mokulonga kwoonanona, nomalongo mbali yimwe kepunga kamu na oitombo ayihe mounda imwe, ngaashi omahumbu mbali nangwe oinyanya mbali. Oitombo oihunga mbali yayo ili shi ngaho, ngaashi ekwiyo nangwe omufenda, oyi kwatwa mo.

faq.q: Oku na ondjalulo yepepa?
faq.a: Ee. Oshipepeta shimwe shi na oomukwaya dwomomapikitho dotatu mo kotjingovi imwe, nomakwaya gashiyali mo kotjingovi yomukwaita, mongeniko shimwe. Kwatha omutumba kokomukwaya kopambanda ku mukwaya gwoshinima shi shi fanekela.

faq.q: Ondjalo ndi kakehe, ino ngeyi u pumbwa okuthaniwa?
faq.a: Ee, ondjalo kakehe, kakuna oshilongo shoshiyetelo, kakuna okuthaniwa nenge okushipaleka. Ota shi kasha monkundana yomukombudha womuwebi mefoni, tabulete nomukombudha.

color-by-number.name: Okuvanga nomanga omalaka
color-by-number.seoTitle: Okuvanga nomanga omalaka: Ondjalo yokukongela yomilando minene, ya kakukwa
color-by-number.h1: Okuvanga nomanga omalaka: Kongela oonyanga, nomalaka ngoo u hala
color-by-number.description: Ombwa yomakwaka minene oo na oomanga, nomatotwa gomalaka mane ga na omalongo gawo. Tokola omalaka, ngo yalithe oonyanga. Kakuna shiyali nenge omanga gokupeta. Ondjalo kakehe, nayo ya shitha.
color-by-number.short: Tokola omalaka, ngo yalithe oonyanga oo na oomanga.
color-by-number.intro: Ombwa yomakwaka minene, imwe nimwe i na omanga, nomatotwa gomalaka mane pamwe nayo, imwe nimwe i na omanga gayo nedina lyayo lyokoshitya. Tokola omalaka omatotwa, ngo yalithe oonyanga. Ombwa oyo ya kala 4 x 4, ino u hala okuwa 6 x 6 nenge 8 x 8 ngele u hala oonyanga dimbwa. Ngele oonyanga kakehe ya na omalaka gomanga gayo, ombwa oyo oya ningwa omupikitho gwomupapela. Oonyanga ya yalithwa nomalaka gashiyali ohagu ya ningwa omupikitho gwoye mwene, ondjalo ina tula shiyali. “Kongela nomanga” ota kongela oonyanga kakehe ya kala tayi yalitha.
howTo: Tokola omvululo gwombwa. 4 x 4 ina oonyanga dinene kuhe, ondjalo ya kakukwa.
Tala pombwa yomatotwa mokombanda yombwa. Omalaka kakehe ina omanga nedina, sho 1 Oshikolokoto.
Tokola omalaka gomatotwa, ngo yalithe oonyanga ngoo u hala.
Ya omalaka gomanga, nenge omalaka ngoo u hala. Oyo ayehe ohayi wapala.
Tokola “Kongela nomanga” ku oonyanga tayi yalitha, “Kalunga” ngele u hala okutandeka ombwa, nenge “Omupikitho gumwe” ngele u hala gumwe gwahafifa.
tips: Ikaleni pedu, mu lundaneko: omumwe ota tokola omalaka, omunene ota yalitha oonyanga.
Shi ekeleni omalaka: “Ndi hala oshiyolo.” Ka pumbwa okuhwepa shotya omupikitho ohagu shi ta ka wa.
Mokombanda ngoo oyo yofitu, ombwa 8 x 8 ota kwatha kolunyanya mokati medi ye nayo. Oonyanga otayi tula sha yaho ya kakukwa.
Ombwa yomupapela ohayi wapala po nomapensele pamhepo yomuhala ogwokulala.

faq.q: Oku na shiyali nenge omanga gokupeta?
faq.a: Kakuna. Kakuna oshiyali, omanga, okubala omanyolo nenge okushunda. U nga oku kwatha nokuli mokapepi, nokukwatha mokati mo oko kwa ka ya nawa.

faq.q: Ngele ndi ya nomalaka gashiyali nomanga?
faq.a: Kakuna shi ta ningwa, ndyoka ondjiwa yomaulongo. Omalaka ngoo oo gonga ota gonga mo nyanga ngoo, kakuna ta ekeleka shiwo. Ngele oonyanga kakehe ya na omalaka gomanga gayo, ondjalo ota gandja olupandu nawa. Omupikitho gwoye mwene gwomalaka goye gu na omalonga nawa.

faq.q: Aantu ya na okutamwa komalaka nawa ota shi tula okulonga omalaka ayo?
faq.a: Omalaka ga gonga ogo ga kwathwa ngaho. Omalaka kakehe ga na omanga, edina lyoshitya nomalonga gawo, ngaashi ngaho komalaka otaku mono oshiyolo ko shikalela. Omalaka ane gaa taluka po nokuyelitha komadjuwa a yela ngeyi ya tamwa komalaka gomalaka, nokuyelitha komadjuwa gomatotwa-omutundu. Aantu yomauwiye oyo ya tamwa komalaka kaya ka mono ndje. Ngele omalaka gamwe gapopi ngahe, tu ipeni.

faq.q: Oonyanga ya kwatha nawa aantu ya na omadjenda nenge ombudha yoka?
faq.a: Oonyanga kakehe ya na pakati pa 48 pixels, nomalongo ga 56 mombwa 4 x 4. Ngele ombwa ya kala minene ko ombudha, ota kwatha kolunyanya mokati mo ombwa yayo, kakuna okukonga oonyanga.

faq.q: Oku na ombwa yomupapela?
faq.a: Ee. Omupapela gumwe ogwe na ombwa yomanga, nomatotwa omalaka mane nedina lyawo. Yalitha oonyanga kakehe nomupensele womalaka gomanga gayo, nenge omalaka ngoo u hala.

faq.q: Ondjalo ndi kakehe, ngeyi u pumbwa okuthaniwa?
faq.a: Ee, ondjalo kakehe, kakuna oshilongo shoshiyetelo, kakuna okuthaniwa nenge okushipaleka. Ota shi kasha monkundana yomukombudha womuwebi mefoni, tabulete nomukombudha.

pattern-maker.name: Omuyelitha womupangelo
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Omuyelitha womupangelo: Yelitha ekwatho nu shitha omupangelo
pattern-maker.h1: Omuyelitha womupangelo: Yelitha ekwatho, u mone li dja mokudalwa
pattern-maker.description: Shandukifa oonyanga yekwatho limwe linini, u mone li dja mokudalwa ko pamhepo, mo omalaka mane ga na edina nomalonga gawo. Kakuna shiyali nenge omanga. Ondjalo kakehe nokushitha.
pattern-maker.short: Shandukifa oonyanga yekwatho linini, u mone li dja mokudalwa ko omupangelo.
pattern-maker.intro: Ekwatho linini lyoonyanga 3 x 3, nenge 4 x 4 ngele u hala, nomupangelo gwoye pamhepo yalyo: ekwatho limwe ali dja mokudalwa mokati mo ombwa. Ninga oonyanga, ota shandukifa komalaka gotaka gomane, gamwe nagamwe nedina lyagwo nomalonga gawo. Omupangelo pamhepo ota shandukifa nokapunga. Kakuna omupangelo gwa ya nawa, kakuna oshi shi kalelwa nenge okutumwa. “Shitha omupangelo gwange” ota shitha omupangelo gu dja mokudalwa pepapela limwe, u ka kale, u yalithe nenge u ka pe omulongo.
howTo: Tala pekwatho nopupangelo pamhepo yalyo. Ali ekwatho limwe, li dja mokudalwa.
Ninga oonyanga. Ota shandukifa komalaka ga tegelelwa mo mo omalaka mane tuu pombanda.
Ninga oonyanga kakehe ngoo u hala, pupangelo opo u ka mono wa ya nawa. Omupangelo gwoye ngo gwa ya nawa.
Ninga “Ndi kundafanehi” ngele u hala ekwatho lipe, nenge “Tandeka nawa” ngele u hala ekwatho lyoshinima. “Shitheni ndje” ota uyeha ekwatho lwoka u li kwafa.
Ninga “Shitha omupangelo gwange” ngele u hala okuli mepapela, nenge ninga Yakula ngele u hala okuyakula.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Talk about what you see: "That looks like a flower." There is no need to name anything.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything I make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. Your tile stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep a pattern, print it.

faq.q: What if I tap the wrong square or clear the tile by accident?
faq.a: There is no wrong square: tap it again to move on to the next color. After "Start again" or "Surprise me", "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each square, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the squares big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every square is at least 56 pixels across. If the tile is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print my pattern" prints the pattern you made on one page, with the four colors and their names, fine in black and white because every color has its own shape.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

drawing-duet.name: Drawing duet
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Picture
drawing-duet.h1: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Sheet
drawing-duet.description: Ovanhu vali ova dhana pa ehala limwe, omuntu nomuntu ane omhango waye. Hakuna omuntu u hinda, hakuna omuwiliko wokuhoolola, nefano lyokuhala nokuprinta. Okuheneka kuli kuhepaneka, kakuna efuko.
drawing-duet.short: Dhana efano limwe pamwe nomuntu ali pembe lyoye.
drawing-duet.intro: Ehala limwe, ovanhu vali. Omuntu nomuntu a hepaneke omhango waye, nomhango nomhango une eli lyawo lyokulemba. Ova dhana ngoye nokuhepaneka: dhana omutya gumwe nolumbu, owa pewa ompeni komuntu omungwe. Omuntu nomuntu ta kwata okuyanda nokuyapuka nako. Hakuna efano lyokuyambeka, hakuna omuwiliko. Ye ta hala efano pevi lyoye, hala opo ofa tanga oku uvamo po efano kepapa, ompeni ovali.
howTo: Omuntu nomuntu a hepaneke omhango waye. Eshamba ota lombwele kuya ohanga ngoye ohepaneka, nomhango wa mulongo wegama lyaye.
Dhana omutya gumwe noluvalo, nompeni, nomutsi. Ye ta kwatapo oshiwa noshikuli nonyoko oko dhana ihaa vulu nompeni.
Ngeno wa hepaneka, nyolela "Ompeni kolela". Omuntu nomuntu ta kwata okuyanda nokuyapuka nako.
Nyolela "Tapululeni omutya wange wokugulu" opo ulanduke omutya gwomuntu u hepaneka.
Nyolela "Hala efano" opo ufa uhange efano kepi lyoyene, nenge "Printa epapa lyomethi" opo ufa uhange epapa limwe nompeni ovali.
tips: Lalelani pamwe nomulonga dhana: "Ndi ta dhana eshi pondjila."
Tandukeni nelino, omutya gumwe nenge oshiwa shoshimwe, nosho omuntu omungwe ta kwatapo.
Kakuna omuntu u dhanga omafano gashihe. Omafano ngoye noyene aga wapaleka nokuli efano lyeshi.
Ngeno wa hala okuyapuka, nyolela "Ndi fa ohoka nakuhe". Efano lyoye kali hokweke ngeno wa tiyopuka epeko, ihe nduno ulihala.

faq.q: Ohaku na omuwini nenge efuko?
faq.a: Ihaa. Hakuna omuwini, hakuna efuko, hakuna etimbo, nohakuna oku ohanga omahepaneko. Hakuna efano lyoshi lyoshinima, naanti ohaa shipalwa nenge ohaa hilikanwa.

faq.q: Efano olika lihala nenge olika lituma?
faq.a: Ihaa, kakuna eshi lituma kepi. Efano olika lihepeke peshe lipopi lyoye ngeno tandu li pwilika. Ngeno wa nyolela Hala efano, efano olika linduno kehe lyoyene ngeno ou lidhenge. Kakuna eshi li yamukwa.

faq.q: Ohe nagwa okutapululako omutya?
faq.a: Eho. "Tapululeni omutya wange wokugulu" olika tapulule omutya gomuntu u hepaneka pamukwate. "Tandukeni efo" olika lipele ehala, nomaa "Ondjila ye" olika kudhuula omitya, omulao gumwe kehe.

faq.q: Ngame ohe ndu tomaka okutumba mouse nenge onyoko yokutsiwa?
faq.a: Eho. Ngeno efano lyoye lili pomhango, omitsi ogu yalo ota kundjuka ompeni yomutya, nelino lyOkahipu lyoompeni olika ihengeka nenge olika kundula. Eshamba lota lombwele "Ompeni ili pombinda" nenge "Ompeni ili pombinda kuli" nokuhepaneka nakuhe.

faq.q: Omahangwa gawo ngeke nagehe, nomuntu u kele nomahonge ga kolola ohe nagwa okuyandja?
faq.a: Ehongo, omashunda, oshikwa nonkiya, omahangwa ngoo ayo tuvakanekwa nomaliko getu gomeemvi dhomafano. Omuntu nomuntu omahangwa aya ane elina lyoshilemba, nomaina olika holoka kepi lyomuwiliko. Omahangwa ogo a kolola nokulonga omulongo womahepaneko ngoo nomahonge ngoo ohadi, ihe omuntu u kele nomahonge ga kolola ihe a dhanga ngoo ihaa.

faq.q: Pali ondjila yepapa?
faq.a: Eho. Nyolela "Printa epapa lyomethi" opo ufa uprinta epapa limwe lyoyene nomalongelo gaagwo nelau lyonene lyoku dhana, oshe ovanhu vali nompeni ovali. Olika shi nongolo nohakuna omushiwa.

faq.q: Ohaku na okulipa nenge oku ukwaatelwa okuyuvitha?
faq.a: Ee, ndi ehe. Ihamu na ondjila yo ukonga, ihamu na okulonga oshiteelelwa kombinga yo, nosho ihamu na okukandjifa. Ota shi longa mocipango kombrauser yo yethimbo, komahoni, komutabuleti nosho komurongwa.

build-together.name: Kulonga pamwe
build-together.seoTitle: Kulonga Pamwe: Anthu Mabeli Ohaa Longa Ondjalo Imwe
build-together.h1: Kulonga Pamwe: Anthu Mabeli, Ongulu Imwe
build-together.description: Anthu mabeli ohaa ningi omahokololo okuyandja echi kongulu lyopamwe, kange mu na ondjila yayo ya nyanyukwa oyo ine edina nomukumo wayo. Ihapu omuwinini, nosho ihamu na omutimba nomaludi. Ehala nokukandjifa ihamu na okulipaleka.
build-together.short: Ningi omahokololo nomuntu ogwo ali kombinga yoye, oku dhenga ongulu imwe yopamwe.
build-together.intro: Ongulu yopamwe yomahoko 4 nomahoko 4, nangwe 3 nomahoko 3 ngeenga ohe hala. Omuntu omwe nomwe ota hopola ondjanyo, nondjanyo imwe nimwe ine edina nomukumo wayo ogu li nawo. Ohamu ningi omahokololo: pomahokololo gaye, ndi tulika esimbo lilihe ohali ku ningi ontanga yoye mo. Ongulu ohayi dhipalwa, osho omaho kale oga dhipala echi, ohaa lombwela ondjalo yimwe mokuyelitha. Ihapu omuwinini, sho mu longa pamwe okwa ya ngoka oshiwana, nosho ihapu okuhangwa nelongo ihali nokutumwa. "Kandjifa ongulu" ota kandjifa ongulu eshiwana ontanga imwe, mu longe nomaludi mabeli.
howTo: Omuntu omwe nomwe ota hopola ondjanyo yaye. Ondjanyo yomuntu mupe ota shi monika ko "Ota longwa".
Omuntu ya kutha ota kutha. Ongoye ota ulike omuntu ota longa nondjanyo yaye.
Tulika esimbo lilihe ondjanyo yoye ohai yi komokati. Omahokololo ohaa yandjiwa komuntu ngoka.
Ngeenge ka hala okuninga ondjanyo, tulika "Kanyaneka". Omuntu nomuntu oha dhi ondjila yokukanyaneka nomomukupi.
Oshi dhipala esimbo lyonkalo lyopamwe, mwa longa ondjalo kombinga. Tulika "Tangila kutya" okulonga imwe ngeenge ohu hala, nangwe tulika Tula ngeenge ohu hala okukala.
tips: Kala pamwe nokuli nomuntu ngoka, ngeno mwa mono nokufika kongoye. Popopyo ulike: "Ame ndi ningi yange ndjoka yoye."
Dhenga esimbo, omilongo, nangwe echi lyoosiyalwa, nangwe ningi ondjanyo ndjoka ohu hala. Ango oshi shiwanenenwa.
Omwana nangwe omuntu ngoka a kotoka nakayi, oha dhi ondjila yokukanyaneka okulonga ngeenge ta hala. Ondjalo ohai dhipalwa pamwe.
Pamaliwa, omuntu nomuntu ota shi longa nomaludi gamwe, nokupopya oshiteelelwa yaye mo omahoko ga kala ohagu.

faq.q: Oku na omuwinini, omutimba nomaludi?
faq.a: Ihamu. Ihapu omuwinini, sho mu longa ondjalo imwe pamwe. Ihapu omutimba, omaludi ga shi ihagu, omaludi ga pewa nangwe okupewa. Ohu na ondjila yokukalulila nale, nokukalulila kombinga yoyeyi oshi shi shiwanenenwa.

faq.q: Ondjalo ndjoka tu longa oi hangwa nangwe oi tumwa?
faq.a: Ihamu. Ongulu ohai kala ko pondjala ei pevi. Ihai hangwa, ihai tumwa nangwe ihai dhipalwa, nosho ohai kuma po ngeno wa pumbwa. Ngeno ohu hala okuhanga, kandjifa ongulu nu longe pamapepa.

faq.q: Ngeenge ndi ningi ondjanyo mo ndjoka ihi shi mo?
faq.a: Ihapu esimbo lihe ndjoka ihi shi mo. Tulika "Ninga ondjanyo yokugwana" omesimbo ohaa uya kuwe. Ohu nga okugwana omukumo gumwe nomukumo gumwe, nomukupi nagwo ohagu gwanenwa.

faq.q: Ovanthu ovo va na okuhalelwa okuyandulwa omaludi, ohava kwathelwa okuyandulula oyanyanyukwa mbika?
faq.a: Oyo ya shi dhenga nokuyandja. Ondjanyo nomuninga ngoka omukumo gwayo gwaludi edina lyoshiteelelwa nongalo yaye ye yoka, nokonkalo ihayi pumbwa oku yandulula omaludi. Oyanyanyukwa 4 ayo yetululwa, nayo ya ningwa nokwa kongelwa omanyanga gotakundi gokuyandulula omaludi, mongalo ya kwathelwa. Ihaa li ko okwa ninga ovanthu ovo va na okuhalelwa okuyandulula omaludi, osho tu pumbwa okukwatulula ngeno omaludi gamwe ngeenge ga ndi gayehe.

faq.q: Oomesimbo ohaa dhi nenekwa ya kwathelwa okuhalelwa ngeenge ko ohawa nenekwa ta lalaka nangwe ko ohawa shikola?
faq.a: Esimbo lihe ohali di koshinyo 56 kuyalela. Ngeenge ongulu ohai di nene ketheko, ohai yalulwa komahokololo gahao mo gayo, ihai shikunina esimbo.

faq.q: Oku na omalombwelo gamapepa?
faq.a: Eyo. "Kandjifa ongulu" ota kandjifa ongulu eshiwana oyo ine omaludi mabeli nomadina gawo, mu longe nomaludi mabeli. Ota shi longa mokasamanena nomokatuka, sho ondjanyo nedhina nomukumo gumwe nagumwe.

faq.q: Ihamu, nongeyi ndi ninga omakwaniko?
faq.a: Eyo, ihamu. Ihapu omukwetu, ihapu okukwaniko nangwe okulonga oshiteelelwa. Ota shi longa mocipango kombrauser yo yethimbo, komahoni, komutabuleti nosho komurongwa.

seated-toss.name: Okuhomola nokusiyalela pehala
seated-toss.seoTitle: Okuhomola nokusiyalela pehala: Omuwiliwili wonkupi ya shi kala po kanena imwe
seated-toss.h1: Okuhomola nokusiyalela pehala: Ohamu homola pamwe kombanda
seated-toss.description: Anthu mabeli ohaa kala kombanda, ohaa tulika omahokololo okuhomola omupilu omunene gwonkupi ku ongulu inene, oha mu dhigililila omahokololo mo pamapepa. Ihapu okutala omaelelo nangwe okutala omalambo. Ehala nokulipaleka.
seated-toss.short: Tulika omahokololo okuhomola omupilu gwonkupi ku ongulu inene, nomahokololo gali mo pamapepa.
seated-toss.intro: Omahoko ga kwiyuka ga anthu mabeli ngoka ya kala kombanda. Ohu tandeka ongulu ya shi lipalekwa komeza, nokutulika omahokololo okuhomola omupilu gwonkupi, nangwe eyuva lyokuzipola lyolwaa, ngeno ehala lyoka li kwate pondoka. Omuntu nomuntu ota dhigililila omahokololo mo pamapepa ngeno ota pandula oitya, nokumona pamwe pamagongalo ngeenge mu shi lipaleka. Ihapu okutala omaelelo, ihapu okuyandula komeza, nosho ihapu okuhangwa nelongo ihali nokutumwa. Tala omalongelo gokutaleka tandi: oomupilu omaninyana ohagu ya pamunwe.
howTo: Tala omalongelo gokutaleka. Tula ko omupilu gwonkupi gunene kuya fala nosho nangwe efuka lyoyeleko lyoshineelwa.
Tulika "Lipalekwa ongulu nombuku yokudhigililila" nu tandeke ongulu ayi pombanda pakati penu.
Kala nomaludi, omuntu nomuntu ko mbambi yonyanga, mu tulike omahokololo gomuntu nomuntu, ngoka gelitho limwe gonkupi. Omuntu ota kutha ota kutha.
Ngeenge omupilu gwawa mo mongulu, dhigililila omahokololo mo mokapiki yoye, po omahoko omo mongulu ngoka.
Tala omahokololo pamwe ngeenge mu lipaleka, nangwe tulika Tula ngeenge ohu hala okuyoola.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "That was a soft one." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is it safe to toss a bean bag?
faq.a: It can be, with care. Use a bag with a sewn-shut cover or a rolled-up sock, never loose beans, rice or small fillings, which are a choking hazard for young children and for anyone who puts things in their mouth. Stay seated, toss gently toward the table and never toward a face, and keep an adult close by.

faq.q: Is anything counted or saved on the screen?
faq.a: No. The tally is only on paper, in boxes you tick yourselves. The page keeps no count and no timer, and nothing is saved or sent.

faq.q: What if someone cannot toss, or the bag lands off the sheet?
faq.a: Anyone may pass, and a bag that lands off the sheet is simply picked up for the next turn. Nothing is counted for it.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page: a large target with its three rings named Near, Middle and Far, a table with a column for each person and a row of small boxes to tick for each ring, and a line of safety advice. The names are written on the rings, so it works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

seasonal-pack.name: Seasonal puzzle pack
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Printable Paper Puzzles
seasonal-pack.h1: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Three Paper Puzzles for Each Season
seasonal-pack.description: Three small printable puzzles for spring, summer, autumn or winter: match the pairs, circle the one that is different, and color a picture in. Choose a season, or take a rest day. Free to print.
seasonal-pack.short: Three printable puzzles for the season you choose, or a rest day.
seasonal-pack.players: All ages, solo or side by side
seasonal-pack.intro: Choose a season, and the page shows three small paper puzzles drawn from that season's pictures: two rows to join with lines, a row of four to circle the one that is different, and a picture to color in. You print one page, then do one, two or all three, at your own pace. Choose "Today is a rest day" instead and there is nothing to do.
howTo: Choose a season, or choose "Today is a rest day".
Look at the three puzzles, then tap "Print this season's pack".
Do one, two or all three, at your own pace.
Join the matching pictures with a line, circle the one that is different, and color the large picture in.
Stop whenever you like. A rest day is a good day too.
tips: Start with the puzzle that feels easiest today. One is enough.
Say the name of each picture aloud, if that helps.
Use crayons or pencils. Any colors are fine.
Keep the page for next time, or let it go.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Does the page know which season it is?
faq.a: No. You choose the season. The page does not look at the date or your location.

faq.q: Is there a score or a right answer?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or checked on the screen, and no answers are shown. Each puzzle is only a picture to look at, join, circle or color.

faq.q: What if nobody wants puzzles today?
faq.a: Choose "Today is a rest day". The page then shows one calm line, and there is nothing to print or do.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page for the season you chose: its three puzzles, each with a short line of how to do it, and a line saying you can do one, two or all three.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

decorate-a-card.name: Decorate a card together
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Decorate a Card Together: a Printable Greeting Card
decorate-a-card.h1: Decorate a Card Together: Make One for Someone
decorate-a-card.description: Two people decorate a printed greeting card for a birthday, a thank you or just because, then write a message on the back together. Crayons or pens only. No timer or score. Free to print.
decorate-a-card.short: Decorate a printed greeting card together.
decorate-a-card.intro: A quiet making game for two people sitting side by side. You print one sheet, which folds in half to make a card. Choose an occasion, such as a birthday or a thank you, and decorate the front around its words. Then write a message on the back, together or one person writing what the other says. Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. There is no right card, and nothing is timed, scored or sent.
howTo: Okutha omuvo, opo odhi tifa "Print the card" (Shiidha ombaka).
Pindika epepa komudhimo pamudhiko wakambudhiwa, ngaho omukanda ta kala kombanda.
Omuntu mumwe ota kongele kombanda, omunadhi ota kongele komundjila, nolwa ta tegelela komundjila gumwe.
Shiidhilweni omawiliko pamwe. Omuntu mumwe ota nyola, omunadhi ota popi omaupyakidhi.
Okaleni ngele ohamu hala. Ekanda lohamu ina oshiwana ohali wa wanenena ngoo ya gwana.
tips: Tameni nomaupyakidhi kombanda, opo mu kongele omaliso, oomauni noomastasi pevi lawo, komutya gumwe.
Ngele omuntu ha hala okukongela, ota ka kwatha omaladhi nenge ota nyola omawiliko.
Popi ngoo ho hala kombinga yomaupyakidhi goye, hamu popi ngele ya wanenena.
Shikwatha ekanda pokati popo ota ka pewa, nenge ngele okwa nyanyukwa okuli li ponhele pehovela pomeza.

faq.q: Ohamu li nomuveli nenge omalongelo?
faq.a: Kaamu. Kamuna wotshi, omalongelo, omakwatho gomakwatho nenge okupondola. Ota kwathela nawa nenge ngoo, nokukwathela pohanga oshiwana ngaashi noupuna.

faq.q: Otu hala omutwi, omasikari nenge omastikeri?
faq.a: Kaamu. Oomakolelo, oomapensela ya kolelwa nenge oomapenela ya feltu oye yo ta wanenena. Ha hala okukeleka, okutema nenge okushtikela.

faq.q: Otu hala okutunga ekanda lomukuthavo gwa ka li mudhiko?
faq.a: Tameni "Ondjo yaayoo" nonyola omawiliko goye pomukanda, nenge ngoo koluhe ota kongele ekanda ihali mudhiko.

faq.q: Pali okuvulwa, okuhwiwa nenge okushiva kombudha?
faq.a: Kaamu. Epepa ota ulike ekanda nomaupyakidhi kuwo. Kaku na ekanda lomeya ohali shiviwa, ohali hwiwa nenge ohali shivwa, kaana ekanda lomaupyakidhi.

faq.q: Pa li mepepa ga pitwa?
faq.a: Epepa limwe: ekanda lilipindikwa lokomukanda, nomaupyakidhi gomudhiko nombinga yekanda lokomunda, nomukanda gwomawiliko nomukanda gwa "Ovo okuza". Omalongo gaantu vali oonaye pe nawa poshitangi.

faq.q: Ota li ondyuwa, kandi otu hala okuyandjudha?
faq.a: Ee, ota li ondyuwa, kaana eyandjudho, kaana okulongisha nenge okukuthudha. Ota shi mo pokupitila mokalunga nopefoni, nomutabla nenge ekomputa.

find-together.name: Find together
find-together.seoTitle: Find Together: Two People Find the Pairs
find-together.h1: Find Together: Two People, One Team
find-together.description: Two people share one screen and take turns turning over two picture cards to look for a pair. Pairs are found together and counted on one shared tally. Free to play, with no timer or score.
find-together.short: Take turns with someone beside you to find the picture pairs.
find-together.intro: The cards start with their pictures showing, or you can lay them face down. On your turn you turn over two cards. If they are a pair, you have found it together and the turn passes. If they are different, they stay face up until you press "Turn them back", so you can both look. Pass at any time. The tally at the top only goes up: the pairs you have found together.
howTo: Tameni omuwa gwomakadhi. Makadhi maneyi, omapaa thatu, ohakwa ndaka pokutameka.
Oshilongo oshi popiwa kutya omuntu ngoo ota kongele, nomudhiko gumwe ngoo ota hala nomukalo gokukulukwa, nomutiyo gumwe ngoo ota hala nomukalo gomakwatho.
Dhimbuluka makadhi mavili, ngaho omukwatho nomukwatho. Ngele ada hamu mana, opaa ota li mbuka pamwe.
Ngele hadhi ka hamu mana, shiidhilweni "Dhimbuluka makadhi" ngele moye otamu kala nawa. Opo omukwatho ota gwedha.
Omumwe nomumwe ota mona okukala "Pasha" nomukalo gumwe. Tameni "Tangeni nawa" omakadhi gatya, nenge tameni okukala pandje.
tips: Kaleni komutwe omukwatho, nolwa popi omapikitaliyo kombinga: "Omutungu gomaai. Ngeno ota nwa omaai nomaliyo?"
Kwatha omuntu ngoo ota kongele okukwashilwa, nangele kwa kala kwa nanenena. Tona pamwe nomukalo, kaana okukwatha ye.
Tameni "Makadhi koopewa" ngele mumwe nomumwe ota hala okukulukwa makadhi okufinda omapikitaliyo.
Omuntu ota tikwa mokaana ota mona okupaa omukwatho ngapi ota hala. Omapaa ota shi dhimbuluka pamwe.

faq.q: Ohamu li nomuhinda, omalongelo nenge omuveli?
faq.a: Kaamu. Kwaa li omuhinda, shaashi mu dhimbuluka omapaa mounyongo. Kwaa li omalongelo, omuveli nenge oomeya ga pumbwa. Omuveli ota shi nenge omapaa mao mu dhimbuluka pamwe, nomuntu ota kwatha nomalongo nawa.

faq.q: Otu pumbwa okudhimbuluka omapikitaliyo ga kala peni?
faq.a: Kaamu. Omalongelo otaga tameka nomapikitaliyo gonde gali mono. Ngele omakadhi gali koopewa, mu li nokuulawa kutya mwa mono ngahelipi, nenge mu dhimbuluka omapaa.

faq.q: Ohamu li shiinini ngele makadhi mavili ga kala ga fa ngoo?
faq.a: Ota ga kala ponhele, mu shi mona nomukalo mu tegelela. Kaku na chike ota ga gwedha ko. Ngele mu li tayari, tameni "Dhimbuluka makadhi" nomukwatho gwa gwedha komuntu mukwao.

faq.q: Omalongelo getu ota kala ngoo ta kondjwa nenge ta tumwa?
faq.a: Kaamu. Makadhi ota kala peni peepeji ei. Kaku na eyandjudho, kaku na okutumwa, kaku na okuhwiwa, ota li paka ngele omepepa ohali pandjuka.

faq.q: Makadhi ohaga kala ngoo ta kwatha omutima gwaana nenge eyapa nini?
faq.a: Makadhi getu ota kala nomadhiladhi 64 nomaliwa, nota kala neyapa okudhimba. Aantu ya shi nokutwa oonekwa noyi lilongo nomapikitaliyo gawo.

faq.q: Ota li ondyuwa, kandi otu hala okuyandjudha?
faq.a: Ee, ota li ondyuwa, kaana eyandjudho, kaana okulongisha nenge okukuthudha. Ota shi mo pokupitila mokalunga nopefoni, nomutabla nenge ekomputa.

story-dice.name: Story dice
story-dice.seoTitle: Story Dice: a Picture Storytelling Game
story-dice.h1: Story Dice: Tell a Story with Pictures
story-dice.description: Three or four picture dice to tell a story with, in any order. No reading, no right answer, no timer and no score. Roll again, or pass. Free to play and print.
story-dice.short: Roll picture dice and tell a story together, in any order.
story-dice.players: 2 or more people, or an adult and a child
story-dice.intro: Omafano gaatatu nosho ga-ne gamonikwa, ngaashi oodise. Gapu-udha omafano gaa-ne, shi-ni oshingo shimwe kombinga yagali. Oshingo oshimwe otashi ka ka ondjovo imwe, nosho ota shi kuhapaleka. Oshingo otashi ka ka shiinima, nosho otashi ka ka shiwa shoshinima shopalaka. Hapu-kala oshingo oshi na omuunya. Tu-li pondjila yomalumbu, nokudja kwoshimbo, ngaashi ope u-na omafano gamwe. "Hukitha komeho" ota pilwa okuhuka omafano gapya, nosho omundu ota kwatela komeho, u-ka pitile ngoo.
howTo: Hangeni omafano gaatatu nosho ga-ne. Gaatatu ngoo tagu-ka pondjila yomukwaanena.
Taleni omafano pamwe. Ndi mu-na okuhimba, mu-ka dhiwe omufano gumwe gwe ta kala ko.
Ombinga oshingo ngaashi ondjila yomalumbu, nosho u-ka kwatele omafano gaa-ne. Oshingo shimwe ashi, shi na ondjovo imwe ihe nongaaka.
Omundu ota dulu okupitila. Tu-li "Pitila", nosho omundu wa landula ota dulu okutanga.
Hukitha omafano gapya ngoo mu-ka pendula, nokuli mu-kwatele "Kala" okukala po.
tips: Tu-ti oupyakudhi, ihe hatu-ka mona omusholo: "Ongaaka omutumba ta ka ka endja kepi?"
Ongaaka omundu e-n-uvu ta tulilwa, mu-ka ghenga komeho kwesho. Oshingo ngoo shi na eshi.
Oshingo otashi ka ka shiwa shonuhamba. Omufano oshimwe ota ka ka oshitya shiwa shokutanga.

faq.q: Ko kuna omaŋgoma nokuli omaŋgoma gomalongo?
faq.a: Ina. Kuna ko oohola, omaŋgoma, omaŋgoma gokudhipaleka nokupwa ohauhe. Mu-ka dhiwa nomukwatelo, nosho okukwatela pomuhela kwoshiwa sha pandje.

faq.q: Ondi mu-na okulongwa nokuhimba omafano?
faq.a: Ina. Eyambo olya-ka ngoo komafano ngaa. Omundu ota dulu okudhimba, okulongwa nokuti ngoo omufano gu-mu-ningi. Kapa omundu ha-ka kwathwa okuhimba nokuli okulongwa oshinima.

faq.q: Ngoo omundu ha-ka hala okutanga pondjila?
faq.a: Ota dulu okupitila nokupya ngoo, ihe ta pitile pahapu. Eyambo olya-ka kala ko, nomundu wa landula ota dulu okutanga, nosho mu-ka dulu okuhukitha omafano.

faq.q: Ko kuna eyambo lyo papiro?
faq.a: Eyo. Ekwatho limwe lomapapiro gaali omafano gaashoka nagali mo mapandje ane. Shi-ni eyambo, nosho mu-ka dhika omafano mo mu-na okudhipaleka.

faq.q: Olya-ka pekwa, nosho ondi mu-na okushilikwa?
faq.a: Eyo, olya-ka pekwa, nosho ihamu-na okukwatela nokuli okushilikwa nokuli okudhimba. Olya-ka shi mu-na pethimbo lyotelefone, pethimbo lyeteyi nokuli kompyuta.

word-and-picture-pairs.name: Oondjovo nomafano
word-and-picture-pairs.description: Kolekela oondjovo dhOshiingilisha komafano gadho, nosho u-uve ondjovo imwe ilongwa. Omafano gaakala pamaalo, ihamu-na eyambo lyomakwatelo, nosho ihamu-na oshiwa shokukolekela. Eyambo olya-ka pekwa nosho olya-ka pitilwa.
word-and-picture-pairs.short: Kolekela ondjovo imwe nomufano gwayo, nosho u-uve ilongwa.
word-and-picture-pairs.players: Omundu mumwe mukulu, nosho ovanyanya ve-ka pamwe
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: Omafano gaane nosho gatandatu gamonikwa, nosho oondjovo dhOshiingilisha dhagali mo dhi na ondjila yakwao. Kanda ondjovo nomufano gwayo, nosho nokudja komufano kondjovo. Omalekelo gapwa gaakwatana mo nomuunya omukulu, nosho ondjovo ya tya "Yakolekelwa". Kanda "Ilonga" pombinga yondjovo imwe, u-uve ilongwa. Ihamu-na eyambo lyokukwatelwa, nosho okukolekela koshiwa kuhapala kayi.
howTo: Hangeni omafano ane nosho gatandatu. Gane gaa-ne ngoo ta ka ka pondjila yomukwaanena.
Kanda ondjovo, nokudja komufano gwa yi. Nosho kanda omufano kwoshe ndjoka, ondjovo yoyo.
Omalekelo gapwa gaakwatana. Okukolekela kayi kuhapala, nosho u-kanda omulumbu mupe.
Kanda "Ilonga" pombinga yondjovo u-uve ilongwa, ngoo elongo lyoye lingi.
Kanda "Omafano gapya" ngoo tagu-ka pondjila yapya, nokuli "Tangathi nomagumbo" okuhaghula omalekelo gaashoka. "Dhika po" ota dhi-ka omalekelo gapondjila.
tips: Ilonga ondjovo imwe nomwe pamwe, ngoo mu-ka kolekele, nosho mu-popye kombinga yomufano.
Ovanyanya mu-ka kwatele omulumbu. Omundu mumwe ota kanda ondjovo nokuli omufano omulumbu.
Tangeni oondjovo dhe mu-dhi shi, nokuli omulumbu gwoye ogu-ka kala pethimbo lyashikola.

faq.q: Ko kuna omaŋgoma nokuli omaŋgoma gomalongo?
faq.a: Ina. Kuna ko oohola, omaŋgoma, omaŋgoma gokudhipaleka nokupwa ohauhe. Mu-ka dhiwa nomukwatelo, nosho okukwatela pomuhela kwoshiwa sha pandje.

faq.q: Eyambo ndyo lyomaana?
faq.a: Lyaloleka ovanhu ovakulu ve ndi ve-hole okuthikama oondjovo dhOshiingilisha, nosho ovanyanya ve-ka pamwe. Ihali lyaloleka omaana.

faq.q: Ngeno eshi-ni ohali lyokulongwa oondjovo?
faq.a: Efuta lya "Ilonga" olya-ka shi-nge oshiwa she shi-na po eshiwa lyoshinima sha pandje. Ngeenge eshiwa ohali lya-longa, efuta ohali lya kala po, nosho eyambo olya-ka hala ko.

faq.q: Ko kuna eyambo lyo papiro?
faq.a: Eyo. Ekwatho limwe lomapapiro gaali omafano gatandatu nooondjovo dhadho dhatandatu, ngoo mu-ka dhika nokuli mu-dhi kwathele nomutanga.

faq.q: Olya-ka pekwa, nosho ondi mu-na okushilikwa?
faq.a: Eyo, olya-ka pekwa, nosho ihamu-na okukwatela nokuli okushilikwa nokuli okudhimba. Olya-ka shi mu-na pethimbo lyotelefone, pethimbo lyeteyi nokuli kompyuta.

sort-together.name: Yoolola pamwe
sort-together.description: Kanda omufano, nosho ekaaka lyoo gwa kala mo: omongeyo nokuli omagumbo, omashiyeleko nokuli omaandje. Eyambo lyokudhipaleka lyomalalakano, lyapekwa, ovakulu novanyanya.
sort-together.short: Tula efano keshe moshimbale shalo: mokombifa ile moshikunino, noikwao vali.
sort-together.intro: Okuyoolola oshi li oshilonga shafiku keshe sha shiivika nawa nohashi shambula, ngaashi okutula po oilandomwa ile okutuwa oikangasho pamwe. Finyina efano, ndele to finyina oshimbale omo li na okukala. Kape na endelelo nokape na epuko.
howTo: Hoolola oshipalanyole: kombifa noshikunino, oiimati noinamwenyo, ile eumbo nelweendo.
Finyina efano. Ohali mono omunghulo wosingo.
Finyina oshimbale omo li na okuya. Efano otali tembuukile moshimbale osho.
Ngeenge oli na okuya moshimbale shimwe, oudano ohau shi popi nombili ndele tau teelele.
Ngeenge omafano aeshe a yoololwa, taleni mo meembale pamwe.
tips: Monghalamwenyo yolela luhapu kape na omanyamukulo a puka. Ngeenge omunhu okwa ti oshikwatelo shokutekela omeva oshi na okukala mokombifa, pula kutya omolwashike. Otashi dulika u mone ehokololo liwa.
Longifa omafano e li etwomonyo leemupopya: "Owa li wa kuna shike moshikunino shoye?"
Okuyoolola oinima yolela, ngaashi eemhindo neendjato ile oombapa komalwaala, oshi li vali oshinyangadalwa shiwa kokule nekoma.

faq.q: Ope na tuu owili yefimbo ile oitwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na owili, oitwa, omuvalu weendaba ile ekanifo. Oto dulu okukanghama pefimbo keshe, nokukanghamena pokati oshi li onghedi iwa yokumanifa.

faq.q: Omolwashike okuyoolola?
faq.a: Ovanhu vahapu ohava hafele okuyoolola shaashi oshi li ngaashi oshilonga shi na oshilonga nosha shiivika nawa. Oshipu yo okupopya kombinga yomafano eshi tamu twikile.

faq.q: Oshali tuu, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshali, nokape na e-akaunta, okulishangifa ile okukutha ko ko-interneta. Ohashi longo mokukongifo ko-web kongodi, kotableta ile kokompiuta.

picture-puzzle.name: Opasela yefano
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Okushiva kwoshiwana kwoshilongo: 4 nosho 9 oonkalo ondjuu
picture-puzzle.description: Okushiva kwoshiwana kwoshilongo kovakulu: 4 nosho 9 oonkalo ondjuu, omufano ogwoka gu-li mo, nosho kanda oonkalo mbali u-di shandukile. Ongaaka omufano gwoye mwene, gu-li mo mo pondjila. Eyambo lyapekwa, ihamu-na omaŋgoma.
picture-puzzle.short: Finyina oitukulwa ivali opo i pingenafane fiyo efano la wanina po.
picture-puzzle.intro: Omufano gwa pandja gwa dhipiwa oonkalo ne nosho ya 9 oonkalo ondjuu, nosho gwa shandukwa. Omufano gwoka gwa kala gwa monika ngaashi omuyambi. Kanda oonkalo imwe, ngoo imwe, nosho ya shandukana. Ihamu-na okuhugunyina. Ongaaka omufano gwoye mwene. Gu-li mo mo pondjila, nosho ihagu-ka tumbulwa.
howTo: Hoolola efano noitukulwa 4 ile 9. Ine osho ehovelo liwa lingungumanifi.
Tala efano alishe pombada.
Finyina oshitukulwa, ndele to finyina ponhele opo shi na okuya. Oitukulwa ivali otayi pingenafana.
Oitukulwa i li ponhele ya yeleka ohai mono edidiliko liwa kanini.
Ngeenge efano la pwa okuwanifwa po, li hafeleni pamwe, ndele tamu hoolola vali likwao.
tips: Okufinyina oitukulwa ivali opo i pingenafane oshipu unene shi dulife okukoka kovanhu vahapu.
Popya kombinga yefano eshi tali hange: "Opo omwalo mutilyane opo."
Opasela yolela yoiti i na oitukulwa inene 12 fiyo 24 nayo oshinyangadalwa shokolupalwena shiwa unene.

faq.q: Ope na tuu owili yefimbo ile oitwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na owili, oitwa, omuvalu weendaba ile ekanifo. Oto dulu okukanghama pefimbo keshe, nokukanghamena pokati oshi li onghedi iwa yokumanifa.

faq.q: Onda pumbwa tuu okukoka oitukulwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Finyina oshitukulwa shimwe, ndele to finyina shikwao, ndele tavi pingenafana eenduda. Osho oshipu unene kukehe ou e na eke tali kakama ile kokakoma kanini.

faq.q: Oshali tuu, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshali, nokape na e-akaunta, okulishangifa ile okukutha ko ko-interneta. Ohashi longo mokukongifo ko-web kongodi, kotableta ile kokompiuta.

finish-the-saying.name: Manifa eyeletumbulo
finish-the-saying.description: Omayeletumbulo a shiivika nawa oo a pumbwa oshitya shaxuuninwa, ngaashi "A penny saved is a penny ___". Finyina ehoololo ile ulika exulilo, ndele tamu popi kombinga yaasho.
finish-the-saying.short: Manifeni omayeletumbulo a shiivika nawa pamwe, ndele tamu popi kombinga yao.
finish-the-saying.intro: Omayeletumbulo akulu luhapu ohaa shiivika moukalamwenyo aushe. Okakalata keshe otaka ulike eyeletumbulo la shiivika nawa la pumbwa oshitya shaxuuninwa, omahoololo atatu, nokambola koku "Ulika exulilo". Konima yexulilo, epulo lombili otali mu hiyi komukundafano.
howTo: Lesheni eyeletumbulo mokule pamwe.
Finyina oshitya tashi li manifa, ile finyina "Ulika exulilo".
Lesha vali eyeletumbulo alishe ndele tamu popi kombinga yalo to longifa epulo olo.
Finyina "Eyeletumbulo tali landula" ngeenge mwe lilongekida.
tips: Lesha ngoo kanini ndele to efa po okambuda komwaka komesho yoshitya shaxuuninwa. Luhapu ovanhu ohave shi tumbula fimbo ino mana.
Ngeenge omunhu okwa yandje exulilo la yooloka, li hafele. Omatumbulo amwe omayeletumbulo ohaa yooloka komapata ile komitunda.
Mongudu, omunhu umwe ota lesha ndele aveshe tave li manyene mexulilo.

faq.q: Ope na tuu owili yefimbo ile oitwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na efimbo tali talwa, eitwa, okuvalula eenghatu ile okukanifa. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe wa hala, nokukanghama pokati oko evelo liwa lokumanifa.

faq.q: Ongahelipi ngeenge otwa hoolola oshitya shi lili?
faq.a: Oudanau otau holola exulilo lo paushitwe ndele tau twikile neenkundana. Kape na eitwa, nenyamukulo li lili oli li ashike nawa.

faq.q: Oshi li ngoo oshali, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshi li oshali, kape na oakaundi, okulishangifa ile okununika sha. Osha longa mefolo lointaneta mongodi, motablet ile mokompiuta.

word-search.name: Okukonga eendjovo meendada dinene
word-search.seoTitle: Oshilongo shomakonde nomaŋgoma: Okudhipaleka, eyambo lyapekwa
word-search.description: Eyambo lyomashilongo gaakonde kovakulu nokovanyanya. Omaindi mahapu, omaandje nomagumbo, mo mu-na ombinga yonene nosho oshiwelelo. Mu-ka dhipaleka mokombinga nokuli mu-ka pudha.
word-search.short: Eendada dinene, eendjovo dinini, okuya kolulyo nopedhi ashike. Oto dulu yo oku di nyanyangida.
word-search.intro: Okagololo kanini ke na eendada dinene neendjovo ashike dinini, adishe tadi leshwa okuya kolulyo ile kombinga yopedhi. Denga kondada yotete yoshitya, opo nee u denge kondada yaxo yaxuuninwa. Owa hala tuu kombaapila? Nyanyangida oudanau mupe nekwato limwe ashike.
howTo: Hoolola oshipalanyole noulapi wokagololo.
Tala melandulafano leendjovo. Eendjovo otadi leshwa okuya kolulyo (kolumosho okuya kolulyo) ile kombinga yopedhi (kombada okuya pedhi).
Denga kondada yotete yoshitya, opo nee u denge kondada yaxo yaxuuninwa.
Oshitya sha monika otashi ningi oulwaala tau vema ndele tashi dhengwa mo melandulafano.
Denga "Nyanyangida oudanau ou" opo u danawine kombaapila nopenzela ile opena.
tips: Ulikeni oshitya melandulafano ndele tamu kongo pamwe ondada yotete.
Kombaapila, opena yomalwaala oipu okukwata shi dulife openzela.
Popileni eendjovo doshipalanyole. Eendjovo doinyandishwa ohadi pendula noupu omafimbo okulikola, okuteleka ile komalandifilo.

faq.q: Ope na ngoo efimbo tali talwa ile eitwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na efimbo tali talwa, eitwa, okuvalula eenghatu ile okukanifa. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe wa hala, nokukanghama pokati oko evelo liwa lokumanifa.

faq.q: Ondi na ngoo oukwatya wokunyanyangida ekongo leendjovo?
faq.a: Heeno. Denga "Nyanyangida oudanau ou" opo u nyanyangide okagololo kopaife meendada dinene, nelandulafano leendjovo koshi yako. Oudanau keshe mupe owe lili.

faq.q: Oshi li ngoo oshali, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshi li oshali, kape na oakaundi, okulishangifa ile okununika sha. Osha longa mefolo lointaneta mongodi, motablet ile mokompiuta.

coloring.name: Omafo okutula omalwaala
coloring.seoTitle: Omashinga gokukalekela ovakulu, goshoka nokupwa, oshiwa
coloring.description: Omafo mapu okupenda ovakulunhu e na eembinga dinene: denga kombinga yelwaala, opo nee u denge pefano. Kape na elunduko, kape na omalwaala a puka, nefo keshe otali dulu okunyingwa oshali.
coloring.short: Denga kelwaala, opo nee u denge kombinga yefano. Oto dulu yo okunyanyangida omafo.
coloring.intro: Omafo e na omalupe manene naapu: onhemo moshiyuma, eumbo, okakopi keeti, embiimbili nowato. Denga kelwaala, opo nee u denge kombinga yefano opo u i yadife. Kape na omalwaala a puka.
howTo: Hoolola efo.
Denga kelwaala. Elwaala keshe ola shangwa edina lalo kulo.
Denga kombinga yefano opo u i yadife nelwaala olo.
Lundulula ediladilo loye efimbo keshe moku i yadifa vali.
Denga "Nyanyangida efo eli" opo u mone efo lihe na sha u li pende neepenzela ile neemakara.
tips: Pa omunhu omalwaala avali opo a hoolole mo ponhele yokumupa aeshe ngeenge okuhoolola otaku shonopeke.
Omiti didilau netango liheeli otai tambulwa ko nawa. Osho sha fimana osho okunyanyukilwa omalwaala, ha okushikula mondjila naanaa.
Omafo a nyanyangidwa ohaa longo nawa neemakara ile neekreiyoni dinene, odo da pupala okukwata.

faq.q: Ope na ngoo efimbo tali talwa ile eitwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na efimbo tali talwa, eitwa, okuvalula eenghatu ile okukanifa. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe wa hala, nokukanghama pokati oko evelo liwa lokumanifa.

faq.q: Omafo aa otaa monika tuu oukekembo unene?
faq.a: Otwa shika oinima i ngungumana naipu ponhele yomaweelelo ovashona, opo omafo a kale e wapala ovakulunhu. Omalupe manene otaa ningi okupenda ku pupale ndele kaku fi kwoukanona.

faq.q: Oshi li ngoo oshali, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshi li oshali, kape na oakaundi, okulishangifa ile okununika sha. Osha longa mefolo lointaneta mongodi, motablet ile mokompiuta.

conversation-cards.name: Ookalata deenkundana
conversation-cards.description: Bildkaarte met saktjuka gesprekstarters vir familie, freunde und ältere Menschen, einschließlich Menschen mit Demenz. Kein Abfragen, keine richtigen Antworten.
conversation-cards.short: Ookalata domafano di na omapulo oukwao naapu. Kape na omayeleko.
conversation-cards.intro: Okalata keshe oka kwatakanifa efano li shivike nehiyo la manguluka lokupopya, ngaashi "Onghalo yombepo ilipi u hole unene?" Kape na omanyamukulo e li mondjila ile oshinima sha pumbwa okudimbulukwa. Hoolola oshipalanyole ile u viakanife adishe.
howTo: Hoolola oshipalanyole, ile u kale ashike na "Ookalata adishe".
Lesha epulo mokule ndele tamu tale efano pamwe.
Pwilikina, popya nenyamukulo loye, ndele tamu efa eenkundana di pite ngaashi da hala.
Denga "Okalata tai landula" ngeenge mwa longekida, ile mu kale pokalata imwe efimbo lile ngaashi mwa hala.
Denga "Nyanyangida ookalata adishe" opo mu nyanyangide kombaapila ndele tamu kelele po.
tips: Nyamukula yo epulo kwoove mwene. Osho otashi monika ngoo eenkundana, ha epulopulo.
Shikula ehokololo, haoukwatya woitya. Ngeenge oinima oya lunduluka, osho oshi li ashike nawa.
Ngeenge okalata oka kumu oshinima tashi nyikifa oluhodi, dimina omaliudo ndele tamu lundulukile nokanghenda kokalata imwe.

faq.q: Omolwashike kuhe na omapulo ngaashi "Owa dimbulukwa tuu…"?
faq.a: Omapulo taa yeleke edimbuluko otaa dulu okukala ngaashi ekonakono nokweetifa efiyo lonyalo. Omapulo a yeuluka ngaashi "Lombwele nge kombinga ya..." otaa efa keshe umwe a kufe ombinga, kashi na nee mbudi kutya oshike e shii.

faq.q: Ondi na ngoo oukwatya wokunyanyangida ookalata?
faq.a: Heeno. "Nyanyangida ookalata adishe" ohashi nyanyangida omusholondondo aushe meendada dinene, ookalata dihapu mefo limwe, da longekidilwa okutetwa mo.

faq.q: Oshi li ngoo oshali, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshali ashike, ndele kapu na omhumbwe yeakaundi, yokulishangifa ile yokundownloada. Ohashi longo mobrowser yointaneta mongodi, motableta ile mokompiuta.

photo-pairs.name: Omafano a faafana
photo-pairs.h1: Omafano A Faafana: Faafanifa Omafano Oye Mwene
photo-pairs.description: Ningeni omafano eni oukwanoombwambwanahambo oudano umbweletele wokufaafanifa. Hoolola omafano 2 fiyo 6 mokalukalwa koye; otaa kala ashike mobrowser yoye noihaa tuminwa kointaneta.
photo-pairs.short: Hoolola omafano oye mwene ndele to a faafanifa. Kape na sha tashi tuminwa kointaneta.
photo-pairs.intro: Okuhandukila: Kukonga omafoto gomomhango yoye 2 kuhika ku 6 okuhuma kocelefone, kotablet nenge kocomputer yoye, ondje ya kala omumwe wo kuhangana, omawanawa manene nenge omafoto gomanenepe ogo ngoo ta hala okuholoka. Omafoto ga kundakanwa mo muuyelele uukwaniilwa ngoo, inaka ya lundunwa, nenge ya katukwa, ihaa ningwa omulandu nenge oshiponga. Omafoto inaga pitwa mo, kanaga kuwanikwa, kanaga kulongelwa ngaashi okuvulwa, kaga pula po ngoo ota kala ko eni. Ngele oho hala, shi tya kwashi onghedi ya vulwa oshimpe ondjiyo dhoka dhomafoto. Ino vulwa oohandukilo ihadhi halele omafoto gomomhango yoye nokuhangana.
howTo: Pa tapaleka "Kukonga omafoto" nokukonga omafoto 2 kuhika ku 6.
Ofoto ngwe ngoo ta holoka omutumba, hano ka tapaleke limwe, opo tapaleke ofoto yalyo ye pameho.
Ngele oho hala, shi tya kwashi oohandukilo ihadhi halele omafoto. Oohandukilo inaka hala ilongwa.
Ihandukeni nawa ketukilo lyofoto nokuhoka ngoo nomatha.
Ngeno wa pumbwa, longa ohuto, kwatheni po pokukala ota tapaleke "Pumbula omafoto". Kanaga kuhulitwa nasha.
tips: Hoolola omafano taa yele nawa oiina iwa nonghalo ya shiivika: oshinamwenyo sheumbo, oshikunino, onhele ya holoka unene, ile efiku lohango.
Omafano eenele noyoikulunima otaa dulu okukala mupu e dulife oipala yovanhu, nohaa kaleke kokule efininiko lokutumbula omamina ovanhu.
Efe po omafano ovanhu ovo va fya ngeenge otaa dulu okweeta oluhodi lwombaadada, kakele ashike ngeenge ou shi shii kutya ohaa eta ehekeleko.

faq.q: Mbela omafano ange ohaa tuminwa konhele yonhumba kointaneta?
faq.a: Ahowe. Epandja ohali lesha omafano oo wa hoolola mondjila yointaneta yoye mwene ndele tali a ulike kosikilini yoye. Ihaa tuminwa kufye ile komunhu umwe e lili, nohaa kana po ngeenge wa pata ile wa tungulula epandja.

faq.q: Mbela oku na o-ola yefimbo ile oimoniwa yoinshingifo?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na o-ola, kape na oinshingifo, kape na okulesha omatando, nokape na ekano. Oto dulu okukanghama pomhito keshe, nokukanghama pokati ondjila iwa yo vene yokumanifa.

faq.q: Mbela ohandi dulu okutuvikila oudano opo tu dane vali oshikando tashi landula?
faq.a: Ahowe mobrowser, oshoka osho sha longekidwa opo kuha tulwe oinima yopaumwene mefilikilo. Okanghalo koshali kaCreative Activities ko-iPhone no-iPad otaka dulu okutuvikila omapeko omafano a hoololwa mokalukalwa koye.

picture-bingo.name: Obingo yomafano
picture-bingo.description: Free printable picture bingo for families, senior groups and care homes. Big pictures with words, 9 or 16 squares, and a large on-screen caller.
picture-bingo.short: Oukalata vobingo yomafano tava nyangidwa nomwiifi wokosikilini inene weengudu.
picture-bingo.intro: Obingo yashikwa i na omafano ponhele yeenomola, opo kapu kale omunhu a pumbwa okulesha outumbulo vanini. Nyangida oukalata va yoolokafana, ndele to longifa omwiifi wokosikilini okuulika efano keshe li li linene kotelevisi, kokompiuta ile kotableta.
howTo: Hoolola eembinga 9 ile 16 kokalata keshe nomuvalu wovadani.
Kanya "Nyangida oukalata". Okalata keshe oka yooloka.
Patulula omwiifi kosikilini inene. Kanya "Efano tali landula" okuulika efano keshe nedina lalo.
Ovadani otava tuvikile efano la faafana kokalata kavo noshimaliwa shoshingeveli, okambate ile oshimaki.
Keshe omunhu ta yadifa omukweyo ile okalata alishe ota pewa olupandu. Kapu na ou ta pondolwa moudano ou: twikileni okudana fiyo keshe umwe a mona omukweyo.
tips: Longifeni oinima inene ngaashi eembate domashako ile oinima yokudanifa inene. Oumbate vanini otava dulu okukala vidjuu okutoolwa po.
Tumbula efano ndele to popi ko sha kombinga yalo: "Oshikepa yomhepo. Olyelye a li nale moshikepa?"
Kuutumbikeni ovo ve na oudjuu wokumona popepi nosikilini, ndele tamu tula ovakwafi pamwe novadani ovo ve va pumbwa.
Eembinga omugoyi odha wana nawa keengudu dihapu. Kalekeni efimbo lokudana li fike popepi nominute 20 fiyo 30.

faq.q: Ongahelipi handi dulu okudanifa obingo yomafano meumbo lefiloshisho?
faq.a: Nyangida okalata kamwe komudani keshe, tula omwiifi kosikilini inenene oyo u na, ndele to ifana omafano kashona nakashona to tumbula edina la keshe limwe. Daneni fiyo keshe umwe a mona omukweyo, opo kuha kale nande oumwe a fiwa po.

faq.q: Mbela oku shi nyangida oshali?
faq.a: Heeno. Nyangida oukalata vahapu ngaashi we va pumbwa, olwovali ngaashi wa hala, okulongifa pwoye mwene ile mongudu.

faq.q: Mbela ovanhu otava dulu okudana kave na okulesha?
faq.a: Heeno. Okambinga keshe oke na efano linene, nedina lalo koshi yalo kwoovo ve hole eendjovo.

picnic-planner.name: Picnic planner
picnic-planner.seoTitle: Picnic Planner: Choose Pictures for an Outing
picnic-planner.h1: Picnic Planner: Choose Pictures, Then Match Them
picnic-planner.description: Choose food and things-to-do pictures for a picnic, then play a gentle matching round with them. Nothing is timed. Free to play and print.
picnic-planner.short: Pick food and outing pictures for a picnic, then match them.
picnic-planner.players: Solo, or 2 people side by side
picnic-planner.intro: Tap pictures of food and things to do to put them in a picnic basket, which holds up to six. A sentence in words says what is in the basket, such as "Our picnic: bread, cheese, apples and a kite." Then tap "Let's play with our picnic" for a gentle matching round made from the chosen pictures. The pictures stay showing, and nothing is timed, scored or saved. "Print our picnic list" prints a checklist of what you chose, with a tick box for each thing to pack.
howTo: Tap a picture of food or something to do. It goes into the basket.
Tap a picture in the basket to take it out again.
Choose at least two things, then tap "Let's play with our picnic".
Tap two pictures that are the same. The pictures stay showing, so there is nothing to remember.
Tap "Print our picnic list" for a paper checklist to take with you.
tips: Ask the people you are with what they would like to bring, and choose the pictures together.
Talk about each picture as it goes in: "Do you remember the kite we flew at the beach?"
On paper, the blank lines are for anything else you want to bring, or for a name.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed or counted, and nobody wins. The matching round has no misses and no points.

faq.q: Is this a meal plan?
faq.a: No. It is a picture plan for an outing, to talk about and to take on paper. It does not say what anyone should eat.

faq.q: Are the pictures we choose saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The basket stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or sent, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print our picnic list" prints one page, on A4 or US Letter. It shows the pictures you chose with a tick box for each, and blank lines for anything else.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

scrapbook.name: Scrapbook
scrapbook.seoTitle: Scrapbook: Turn Family Photos Together, Page by Page
scrapbook.h1: Scrapbook: Add Your Photos and Captions, Then Turn the Pages
scrapbook.description: Choose two to twelve of your own family photos on your device and turn them as a book, with a few words under each. Nothing is uploaded. Free to print.
scrapbook.short: Page through your own family photos together, like a book.
scrapbook.players: Solo, or 2 people side by side
scrapbook.intro: Choose two to twelve of your own photos from this device. Each photo becomes one page of a book, large enough to see, with an optional few words under it. Turn the pages with the buttons or the arrow keys, and use "Look together" to sit side by side with just the photos and words. Your photos stay on this device. They are not uploaded or saved, and the book is gone when you close the page. "Print the scrapbook" prints one photo and its words on each page, with page numbers.
howTo: Tap "Choose photos" and pick two to twelve photos. Ask before using a photo of someone who cannot say yes.
Turn the pages with "Previous page" and "Next page", or with the Left and Right arrow keys.
Add a few words under a photo if you like. Use "Move earlier" or "Move later" to change the order.
Tap "Look together" to hide the editing controls and look at the book side by side.
Tap "Print the scrapbook" for a paper copy, or "Clear the book" when you are done. Nothing is kept.
tips: Wähle Fotos von schönen, vertrauten Dingen: einem Garten, einem Haustier, einem Lieblingsort. Sprecht über jede Seite, während ihr sie umblättert.
Lassen Sie die Person zu jeder Seite ein paar Worte sagen, auch nur ein einziges Wort, und schreiben Sie diese genau so auf, wie sie gesagt werden.
Auf Papier können die gedruckten Seiten in einen Ordner kommen, und die Familie kann eigene Bilder und Notizen rund um sie herum ergänzen.

faq.q: Gibt es einen Timer, eine Punktzahl oder einen Gewinner?
faq.a: Nein. Nichts wird gemessen, gewertet oder gezählt, und niemand gewinnt. Die Seitenzahl dient nur dazu, dass Sie wissen, wo Sie im Buch sind.

faq.q: Werden unsere Fotos oder Bildunterschriften gespeichert, hochgeladen oder gesendet?
faq.a: Nein. Die Fotos werden nur auf dieser Seite gelesen; sie werden nicht hochgeladen, gespeichert oder irgendwohin gesendet. Die Bildunterschriften bleiben nur so lange erhalten, wie die Seite geöffnet ist. Wenn Sie die Seite schließen, ist das Buch verschwunden.

faq.q: Können wir das Buch drucken?
faq.a: Ja. Mit „Das Fotobuch drucken“ wird auf jeder Seite ein Foto mit seiner Bildunterschrift gedruckt, dazu die Seitenzahlen. Wählen Sie im Druckdialog A4 oder US Letter.

faq.q: Ist es kostenlos, und muss ich mich registrieren?
faq.a: Ja, es ist kostenlos, und es gibt kein Konto, keine Registrierung und keinen Download. Es funktioniert im Webbrowser auf einem Smartphone, Tablet oder Computer.

collage-board.name: Collage-Brett
collage-board.seoTitle: Collage-Brett: Zwei Personen legen Bilder abwechselnd an
collage-board.h1: Collage-Brett: Bilder abwechselnd auf einem Brett platzieren
collage-board.description: Zwei Personen legen abwechselnd ausgeschnittene Bilder auf ein gemeinsames Brett. Tippen Sie auf ein Ausschnittbild und dann auf einen freien Platz. Keine Zeitmessung und keine Punkte. Kostenlos zum Spielen und Drucken.
collage-board.short: Legen Sie abwechselnd Bilder auf ein gemeinsames Brett.
collage-board.intro: Zwei Personen sitzen nebeneinander vor einem Brett mit zwölf Plätzen und einem Behälter mit acht ausgeschnittenen Bildern. Tippen Sie auf ein Ausschnittbild und dann auf einen freien Platz; das Bild wird dorthin gelegt. Danach ist die andere Person an der Reihe. Die Bilder jeder Person tragen eine eigene Form, einen Kreis oder ein Quadrat, sodass man sieht, wer was gelegt hat, ohne sich auf die Farbe verlassen zu müssen. Jede Person kann aussetzen, und ein Schritt kann zurückgenommen werden. Nichts wird gemessen, gewertet oder gespeichert. „Das Brett drucken“ druckt das leere Brett und die Bilder zum Ausschneiden.
howTo: Tippen Sie im Behälter auf ein Ausschnittbild. Solange es ausgewählt ist, steht dort „Ausgewählt“.
Tippen Sie auf einen freien Platz auf dem Brett. Das Ausschnittbild wird dorthin gelegt, und die Reihe wechselt.
Jede Person kann jederzeit auf „Aussetzen“ tippen oder auf „Letztes Bild zurücknehmen“, um einen Schritt rückgängig zu machen.
Tippen Sie auf „Anderer Satz Bilder“ für einen anderen Behälter. Bilder, die schon auf dem Brett liegen, bleiben dort, wo sie sind.
Tippen Sie auf „Neu beginnen“, um das Brett zu leeren, und auf „Zurücklegen“, wenn Sie es sich anders überlegen.
tips: Sagen Sie den Namen jedes Bildes, wenn es gelegt wird, etwa „die Teetasse kommt neben das Haus“. Das Sprechen macht die Tätigkeit zu einer gemeinsamen Sache.
Lassen Sie beide Personen abwechselnd das Ausschnittbild wählen und nicht nur den Platz, damit jede mitentscheiden kann.
Auf Papier schneiden Sie die acht Bilder mit etwas Hilfe aus und legen sie dann auf die gedruckten Felder.

faq.q: Gibt es einen Timer, eine Punktzahl oder einen Gewinner?
faq.a: Nein. Nichts wird gemessen, gewertet oder gezählt, und niemand gewinnt. Ein volles Brett ist einfach eines, auf dem an jedem Platz ein Bild liegt.

faq.q: Werden die Bilder, die wir legen, gespeichert oder gesendet?
faq.a: Nein. Das Brett bleibt nur auf dieser Seite. Es wird nicht gespeichert, hochgeladen oder gezählt und ist weg, sobald Sie die Seite schließen.

faq.q: Woran erkennen wir, welches Bild wem gehört?
faq.a: Jede Person hat eine Form. Die Bilder der ersten Person haben in der Ecke einen Kreis, die der zweiten Person ein Quadrat; über dem Brett wird jeder Name angezeigt.

faq.q: Gibt es eine Version auf Papier?
faq.a: Ja. „Das Brett drucken“ druckt das leere Brett als zwölf Felder, darunter die acht Bilder in gleicher Größe und mit der Schnittlinie. Das Ausschneiden kann eine erwachsene Person übernehmen.

faq.q: Ist es kostenlos, und muss ich mich registrieren?
faq.a: Ja, es ist kostenlos, und es gibt kein Konto, keine Registrierung und keinen Download. Es funktioniert im Webbrowser auf einem Smartphone, Tablet oder Computer.

garden-planner.name: Gartenplaner
garden-planner.seoTitle: Gartenplaner: Ein Beet aus Pflanzenbildern gestalten
garden-planner.h1: Gartenplaner: Bilder auswählen und ein Beet gestalten
garden-planner.description: Wählen Sie Bilder von Pflanzen und Gartendingen und legen Sie sie in zwölf Beete einer Fläche. Tippen Sie auf ein Bild und dann auf ein Beet. Keine Zeitmessung und keine Punkte. Kostenlos zum Spielen und Drucken.
garden-planner.short: Wählen Sie Pflanzenbilder und gestalten Sie eine Fläche mit zwölf Beeten.
garden-planner.intro: Wählen Sie Bilder aus einem Behälter mit Pflanzen und Gartendingen und tippen Sie dann auf ein Beet, um jedes Bild einzusetzen. Eine Fläche hat zwölf Beete, und in jedem Beet hat genau ein Bild Platz. Eine Zusammenfassung in Worten zeigt, was der Plan enthält, etwa „Ihr Plan hat 3 Sonnenblumen, 2 Rosen und 1 Baum.“ Nichts wird gemessen, gewertet oder gespeichert, und es gibt keine Reihenfolge. Dies ist ein Bildplan zum Besprechen, keine Anleitung zum Pflanzen. „Den Plan drucken“ druckt die Beete mit den gewählten Bildern, dazu leere Beete zum Zeichnen und Linien für Notizen.
howTo: Tippen Sie im Behälter auf ein Bild. Solange es ausgewählt ist, steht dort „Ausgewählt“.
Tippen Sie auf ein Beet. Das Bild wird dorthin gesetzt, und die Auswahl ist abgelegt.
Um ein Beet zu ändern, wählen Sie ein anderes Bild und tippen Sie auf das Beet. Um ein Beet zu leeren, tippen Sie darauf, ohne ein Bild ausgewählt zu haben.
Tippen Sie auf „Neu beginnen“, um alle Beete zu leeren, und auf „Zurücklegen“, wenn Sie es sich anders überlegen.
Tippen Sie auf „Den Plan drucken“ für eine Papierfassung der Fläche und der Zusammenfassung.
tips: Talenu kombinga yepikitsha nepikitsha ngeenge li yandjwa mo, ngaashi "ondjamba oyi kala pevi lyondjuwo yondjuwa". Okutala okwa kwashiteelela oshinima shopamwe.
Mu pe omunhu kehe okukonga epikitsha omutuma, nenge mu kongele epikitsha pamwe, opo aantu yo mbali ya kale nawa ohapo lyoshinima.
Papepa, oshilumbo shelipwa ohashi shi okulemba omaupyakidi goye, noimwe yomalikanwa oshi kwatelwa okulemba oshinima shoye nomaupyakidi.

faq.q: Oshinima oshi ohashi lombwelela okulima?
faq.a: Kashi shi. Oshi oshipango shepikitsha shokutalela, kashi shi lombwelela okulima. Kashi shi ulike nokuli nelitha, nenge nduno, kulongwa kombinga yomukalo woo ulikalo, ngeenge iho tuu.

faq.q: Okuna onghulu, omaupyakidi nenge ohapo?
faq.a: Kashi shi. Kashi kwa linganithwa onghulu, kashi kwa pewa omaupyakidi, kashi kwa wanenwa, nomunhu kehe kashi a shi ohapo. Oshilumbo shoshi shi shi uzwa oshinima shi ka sheka ngoo oshi shi tula.

faq.q: Epikitsha tuu lya pewa lyo kanyanyeko nenge lya tumwa?
faq.a: Kashi shi. Oshipango oshi kala pevi lyeyi pauyo tuu. Kashi shi ulikwa, kashi shi tumwa, kashi shi wanenwa, noshi kwathela ngeenge mu kuhe ekwatelo lyeyi.

faq.q: Okuna omaupyakidi gomapepa?
faq.a: Ee. "Okuprinta oshipango" ohashi printa ompango imwe, pa A4 nenge US Letter. Ohashi lombwela omitanda ye 12 nepikitsha lyomunhu yo ya pilwa, oshiwa shoshiwa, nomitanda yokulemba omaupyakidi.

faq.q: Ohali lipwa, nondi kala nokuwilika?
faq.a: Ee, ohali lipwa, kakuna onghedi yokukala nelongo, kakuna okuwilika nenge okukuluka. Ohali shi mwa mo mothani yomahangano ngeenge li pevi lyelipwa, nenge tablet, nenge komputa.

coloring-wall.name: Elumbo lyokulelonga kopamwe
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Elumbo Lyokulelonga Kopamwe: Epikitsha Limwe Nomaanya Mengi
coloring-wall.h1: Elumbo Lyokulelonga Kopamwe: Epikitsha Linene Lyelelonga Kopamwe
coloring-wall.description: Printa epikitsha linene pamapepa mamwe, opo omalumba, ehangano lyomashikola nenge ehangano lyokukalela aalumbu ya kale nokulelonga elumbo limwe kopamwe. Ohali lipwa okuprinta. Kakuna onghulu nenge onghedi yokuwanenwa.
coloring-wall.short: Printa epikitsha linene pamapepa aanandjanda ne aantu mengi ya lelonge.
coloring-wall.intro: Konga epikitsha pamapepa okulelonga nelumbo lomapepa 4, 6 nenge 9. Printa elumbo: epepa lyotete ohali lombwela onghedi yokuli kwatapo, nomapepa gamwe kehe ohali ga epikitsha limwe lyeshi epikitsha linene, nelitha ngaashi A1 kombelewa yaro. Omunhu kehe ohali lelonga epepa limwe nenge mawa, nomaliko nonghedi yoye ya ka. Mapepa oga kwatelwa po nomalitha goye, noga kwatwa nelapa kombinga yomuunda. Kakuna onghulu, kakuna onghulu yokuwanenwa, kakuna okukala.
howTo: Konga epikitsha, opo to konga omuwa womapepa elumbo li na.
Wa kanitha omapa oo li ri pomukanda, oo ta lombwela opo kohi ya kwatelwa elitha kehe.
Gwedha "Printa elumbo" opo u printe omapepa gaashoka.
